title: Massive Recipe Expansion (v0.31.0)
description: Soup CLI v0.31.0 expands the recipe catalog from 46 → 80. Vision (Pixtral, Qwen2-VL, InternVL, MiniCPM-V), audio (Qwen2-Audio, Whisper-large-v3, SeamlessM4T-v2), reasoning (all 6 DeepSeek-R1-Distill sizes, Qwen3-Coder, Phi-4 reasoning), edge (SmolLM2, Phi-3.5-mini), domain specialists (BioMistral, Meditron, CodeLlama, Magicoder, Mathstral, Nemotron-4).

blocks.html:
Massive Recipe Expansion (v0.31.0)

v0.31 grows the recipe catalog from 46 → 80 ready-made configs. Every category gets first-class coverage — vision, audio, reasoning, edge, domain specialists, and multimodal reasoning.

This page records the v0.31 expansion. The catalog today has 171 recipes at v0.77.0: see Recipe catalog for every one, and for what changed in v0.77.0 (two added, one removed, two marked unavailable) and v0.76.0 (nine added, six removed).

What's new

blocks.code:
soup recipes list                    # browse the full catalog (171 recipes)
soup recipes search vision           # filter by category
soup recipes search reasoning
soup recipes search edge
soup recipes use llama3.2-vision-grpo

blocks.html:
Vision (multimodal)

  • Pixtral-12B-2409 — pixtral-12b-sft + pixtral-dpo (the DPO recipe was not usable as shipped through v0.76.1, tracked as #1867: its llava data format has no chosen and rejected columns. Since closed in v0.77.0: pixtral-dpo was retired, because its vision rows could not train as preference rows, and v0.77.0 refuses them at config load, #2064)
  • Qwen2-VL — 7B + 72B (FSDP2 multi-GPU)
  • InternVL 2.5 — OpenGVLab vision
  • MiniCPM-V 2.6 — compact vision
  • Llama-3.2-Vision GRPO — multimodal reasoning (at v0.77.0 the GRPO trainer still loads the base as a text-only causal LM with a tokenizer and no vision processor, so this recipe does not train on the images; see GRPO Plus)

Audio (speech)

  • Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct — speech understanding
  • Whisper-large-v3 — ASR fine-tune: use whisper-large-v3-asr (the task: asr recipe); whisper-large-v3-ft is the generic audio SFT path
  • SeamlessM4T-v2 — speech translation

Reasoning

All 6 DeepSeek-R1-Distill sizes ship as recipes:

  • Qwen 1.5B / 7B / 14B / 32B
  • Llama 8B / 70B

Plus Qwen3-Coder 30B, Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning (MoE), and Phi-4 reasoning.

Small / edge / mobile

  • SmolLM2 — 135M / 360M / 1.7B
  • Qwen2.5 — 0.5B / 1.5B / 3B
  • Gemma 2 — 2B
  • Phi-3.5-mini — 3.8B
  • Llama-3.2 — 1B / 3B

Domain specialists

  • Medical — BioMistral 7B, Meditron 7B
  • Code — CodeLlama 13B / 70B, Magicoder 6.7B
  • Math — Mathstral 7B
  • Finance — Llama-2-13b-finance starter
  • Mega-scale — Nemotron-4 340B (NVIDIA)
